input.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The Export button remains disabled after a failed export because the `handleClick` function does not reset the `busy` state when the `exportReport` promise rejects. This causes the UI to stay stuck, requiring a page reload to recover.

input.title: Re-enable Export button after failed export by clearing busy state in error path
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `handleClick` function sets `busy` to `true` at the start of the export but only resets it in the `.then()` callback for successful exports. If `exportReport` fails (e.g., due to a non-2xx response), the `busy` state remains `true`, disabling the button indefinitely. To fix this, the `catch` block should also set `busy` to `false` and show an error toast. This ensures the button is re-enabled after a failed export attempt.
